tenderSchedule.title: Transportation of Milk through Insulated Road Milk Tankers from Mysore Milk Union Ltd. to Co-Packing Units of Tamil Nadu for the period of two years on contract basis
tenderSchedule.description: Transportation of Milk through Insulated Road Milk Tankers Capacity of 19 KL, 24 KL and 30 KL from Mysore Milk Union Ltd. to Co-Packing Units of Tamil Nadu and other co-packing units for the period of two years on contract basis.
tenderSchedule.deptName: Karnataka Co-operative Milk Producers Federation Limited
tenderSchedule.locationName: Managing Director Mysuru District Co-operative Milk Producers Societies Union Limited PUR

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder should attach three years IT returns, PAN, GST, Balance Sheet with CA certification and Registration Certificate
Bidder should submit RC book, FC, Road Permit tax, Vehicle Insurance, FSSAI, Emition Test, IT and other related documents without fail

The contractors must have Food Safety & Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) license of Tankers. The Road Milk Tankers offered for tender must be of the 2026 models incorporating the latest improvements in design.
Bidder should be abide as per the terms & conditions mentioned in tender documents
